purpose: Human support labels on MASKED retrieval contexts, so the Layer-3 interaction can be estimated jointly under the temporal mask and human labels.
weighting_note: Strata are sampled equally, NOT proportionally, so every population estimate must be weighted by strata[*].weight. An unweighted mean over this pack is not a population quantity.
blinding: Annotators receive no model, condition, automatic label or stratum. The key is in item_metadata.jsonl.
